limitations: A structural extension of recent finite-matrix symmetric-modulus inequalities. It does not establish a full generalized-singular-value theorem, does not treat arbitrary unbounded measurable operators, and the normalized center-valued half-dimension conclusion requires finiteness.
provenance: Scientific sources and audit evidence are listed in RESULT.md, REVIEW.md, and the independent-audit files dated 2026-10-01.
record_title: Polar-wandering spectral projections for symmetric moduli in von Neumann algebras
